title: Delivery-drone mission and flight-log review
subtitle: 20.25 km out-and-return mission, release interface and test findings
description: An eight-page review comparing early commissioning logs with the matching 21 January mission, including mission distance, control tracking, release commands, vibration, failsafes, power telemetry and project screenshots.
scope: The 20.25 km distance is verified by GPS-position integration and cross-checked against groundspeed. It is total out-and-return travel, not a one-way radius. The 5 kg payload and delivery outcome are confirmed by the project owner; the log records release commands but does not measure payload mass. The attached report documents the radio failsafe, vibration/clipping and power-telemetry findings.
source: Retrospective engineering report prepared for the Achraf RAHIBE portfolio, 28 October 2026. Raw flight logs retained privately.
captions: Report cover: verified mission metrics, supplied aircraft screenshot and evidence boundaries.
Mission-profile page: GPS distance and altitude plots without geographic coordinates.
